run_slam_publisher_node: run the slam republisher ROS node to broadcast robot pose transforms
create_slam_publisher_instance: create a SlamPublisher instance that subscribes to /poseupdate and broadcasts TF transforms
review_slam_publisher_cb: review the SlamPublisher _cb callback that converts PoseWithCovarianceStamped to TransformStamped
refactor_slam_publisher_child_frame: refactor the SlamPublisher _cb method to use a configurable child_frame_id instead of hardcoded odom
summarize_slam_publisher_class: summarize the SlamPublisher class that republishes robot pose data as ROS TF transforms
